title: Ipswich: McAteer's first goal can't hide a leaky back line
body:
Ipswich boss David Wright has spoken up for Mary McAteer after her first goal for the club, praising her football intelligence [S1].

The praise centred on her reading of the game, and the manager was speaking about a Wales international [S1].

The numbers behind the mood are less comfortable. Over their last five league matches, Ipswich have won one, drawn two and lost two, collecting five points [ST1]. They have scored eight and conceded nine, with the sequence reading WLDDL [ST1]. The attack is creating enough to stay in games, but a back line that leaks this often turns every close match into a coin toss.

Fans have heard plenty of upbeat quotes during rough spells, and a good debut goal makes a lovely headline. But a side that lets in this many will keep handing away points it has earned. The praise is deserved; the question is whether the rest of the work can back it up.

The Touchline Take: enjoy the moment, but judge this side on its defending and its next run of results, not on a single goal.
